radiology_report: Prostate volume: 46.38 cc. PSA density: 4.097 ng/mL/cc. PI-RADS: 5.
pathology_report: The patient underwent one biopsy session. At biopsy, Gleason 4+3 (ISUP grade group 3) was identified in the left peripheral zone (apical); cribriform pattern and perineural invasion were present. The reported histological growth pattern was: Adenocarcinoma with mostly moderately to poorly formed tubules that often fuse and regularly form cribriform areas. Also, quite a few well-formed tubules.
surgical_pathology_report: The robot-assisted radical prostatectomy specimen showed Gleason 3+4 with tertiary pattern 5 (ISUP grade group 2), pathological stage pT3b. Extraprostatic extension was present; surgical margins were positive; the seminal vesicles were invaded; lymphovascular invasion was present; lymph node metastasis was present.
